prompt: What radio projects did Electronics Australia publish in the 1960s and 1970s? I'm interested especially in solid state regenerative radios capable of receiving short wave transmissions.
response: Electronics Australia published numerous radio projects in the 1960s and 1970s, including many regenerative designs. However, most of these were focused on AM broadcast band reception, and few were capable of short wave reception. Vacuum tube designs were more common, with solid state projects becoming prevalent in the late 1970s. Short wave reception was typically addressed with more complex superheterodyne designs.
